notes: Janish & Pinetti (arXiv:2310.15395): search for a narrow DM decay line in JWST NIRSpec IFU blank-sky spectra (GN-z11 field). New observed 2sigma power-constrained limits on g_agamma over 0.8-3 eV, excluding g_agamma > 2.4e-11 GeV^-1 at m_a = 1 eV and > 9.4e-12 GeV^-1 at m_a = 2.15 eV (best point). Also limits on DM lifetime tau (< 6.7e26 s at ~0.86 eV excluded). Full exclusion curve is only in Fig. 2 (not digitizable from text); the two emitted points are explicit text values. Paper also gives projections ('current data' reach 3.7e-12, 15-yr reach 2e-12 GeV^-1), but the primary result is the measured limit, so is_projection=false. Assumes NFW halo (rho_s = 0.18 GeV/cm^3, r_s = 24 kpc) with D-factor ~7.5 GeV kpc/cm^3 for the line of sight; not a local-density haloscope assumption, so dm_density_assumed is null.
